import.title: Import an encrypted session
import.description: Import an existing encrypted session. Enter the directory containing session.imvault and device.imvault, and the matching key path. An existing production.imvault is preserved; otherwise bundled common protocol parameters are used. This step checks files offline. After setup, read-only cloud vehicle data is polled every five minutes; reads may wake the vehicle.

sms.title: Phone and SMS login
sms.description: Enter a mainland China mobile number and submit to send an SMS, then enter the verification code. Account encryption keys are generated locally. HA configuration does not store your phone number. A valid pending challenge is resumed without another SMS. After setup, read-only cloud vehicle data is polled every five minutes; reads may wake the vehicle.

sms_code.title: Enter SMS verification code
sms_code.description: Enter the code from your SMS and submit. To request another SMS, select resend and leave the code empty. Wait at least 60 seconds between sends. This flow expires after 10 minutes; the server may expire the code sooner.

paths.title: Update paths or resume requests
paths.description: Cloud requests stop after a failure. After offline review or recovery, select resume. Unresolved refresh attempts continue to block requests.

error.invalid_vault: Unable to read encrypted account files or protocol configuration. Check the key, directory permissions, client identity and pending state.
error.login_required: Session expired or refresh metadata incomplete. Reauthenticate by SMS or import a valid session.
error.invalid_phone: Enter an 11-digit mainland China mobile number without +86, spaces or other characters.
error.invalid_code: Enter a verification code of 4 to 8 digits.
error.sms_cooldown: Wait at least 60 seconds after the last SMS request before submitting again.
error.sms_rejected: The server rejected the SMS request. Check your account and try again later.
error.login_rejected: The server rejected login. Check your code, or select resend to request a new code.
error.code_expired: The local verification flow expired. Select resend to request a new code.
error.invalid_storage: Unable to initialize local account storage. Check permissions in the HA configuration directory. For existing data, restore the matching key and storage marker; missing or damaged keys are never replaced automatically.

abort.already_configured: This client identity is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Client identity differs. Add a new integration.
abort.captcha_required: The server requires image or risk verification, which this HA flow does not support. Complete verification through official channels before trying again.
abort.account_binding_required: The server requires account binding. Complete it in the official app first.
abort.unresolved_request: A request outcome is unknown, or a login/refresh request is unresolved. Requests stopped. Review retained encrypted state before continuing; do not delete pending files to bypass checks.
abort.login_response_invalid: The login response was retained encrypted but could not be committed as a valid session. Review it and use recover-login offline. The code will not be submitted automatically again.
